description: Mint a signed harness passport SPOC will witness. Bearer auth (spk_live_...) upgrades the tier to principal-linked; otherwise anonymous. Returns the envelope, envelope signature, signing key version, expiry, and a one-time reporting_key for HMAC-authenticating reported events.

scopes.description: Scopes the harness may exercise (e.g. tools:web-search).

task_id.description: Optional task id to bind the passport to.

trust_tier.description: Requested tier. Ignored if it conflicts with the presented auth (bearer → principal-linked, X-Attested-Publisher → attested, otherwise anonymous).

ttl_seconds.description: Requested TTL in seconds. Capped by trust tier.

name: spoc.harness.issue
title: Issue a harness passport
